description.value: A historic waterfront institution on Qualicum Beach's Island Highway, The Shady Rest has operated since 1924 and encompasses a family-friendly restaurant, an adult-only (19+) pub, and a liquor store — all perched on the shore with ocean views. The pub rotates local craft taps and hosts weekly live music and trivia nights. Takeout is available by phone, making it a practical stop for cyclists passing through on the Island Highway.
